image_description: A close-up view of an ornate, dark metal breastplate (part of a suit of armor). The surface is polished but appears aged or patinated, featuring embossed floral or scrollwork designs on the upper chest area. Visible components include the main torso plate, a pauldron (shoulder guard) on the left with layered lames, and rivets along the bottom edge. The lighting creates strong specular highlights, emphasizing the curvature and metallic texture.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal objects or other armor types.
To analyze the realism of the metallic reflections, patina, and embossed textures for any AI-generation anomalies.
To verify the physical connectivity between the main breastplate and the shoulder lames, ensuring no floating elements or fusion artifacts.
To ensure the embossed designs have correct depth relief and do not appear as flat textures mapped onto a curved surface incorrectly.

focus_areas: Metallic reflectivity and specular highlights consistency
Physical connectivity of shoulder lames to main plate
Depth and realism of embossed ornamental patterns
Edge sharpness and absence of melting/fusion artifacts
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the embossed patterns and the light reflections. In AI images, embossed details often fail to cast micro-shadows or distort reflections correctly. Verify if the 'patina' looks like natural oxidation or inconsistent noise. Check the rivets for uniformity and physical plausibility.
